name: PubSub to Kafka Avro — Vertex ML Logs
description: Reads Cloud Logging entries from a Pub/Sub subscription, maps them to the appropriate Avro schema and publishes to a Google Managed Kafka topic using the Confluent wire format.

parameters.name: log_type
parameters.label: Log Type
parameters.helpText: Type of Vertex AI log to process. Determines mapper and Avro subject. One of: online_prediction, batch_prediction, monitoring, training.

parameters.name: kafka_bootstrap_servers
parameters.label: Kafka Bootstrap Servers
parameters.helpText: Comma-separated Kafka bootstrap server(s). For Google Managed Kafka: bootstrap.CLUSTER.REGION.managedkafka.PROJECT.cloud.goog:9092

parameters.name: kafka_topic
parameters.label: Kafka Topic
parameters.helpText: Destination Kafka topic name, e.g. dev-enriched-vertex-logs.

parameters.name: kafka_registry_url
parameters.label: Schema Registry URL
parameters.helpText: Base URL of the Confluent-compatible Schema Registry. For Google Managed Kafka: https://managedkafka.googleapis.com/v1/projects/PROJECT/locations/REGION/schemaRegistries/REGISTRY_ID

parameters.name: dlq_bucket
parameters.label: Dead-Letter Queue Bucket
parameters.helpText: GCS bucket name (without gs://) where failed messages are written.

parameters.name: window_size_seconds
parameters.label: Window Size (seconds)
parameters.helpText: Fixed window size in seconds. Default: 10.

parameters.name: schema_cache_ttl_seconds
parameters.label: Schema Cache TTL (seconds)
parameters.helpText: How long workers cache schemas locally before re-fetching. Default: 300.
